def Mcd.IsSQS.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} B => (∀ X ∈ B, X.card = 4) ∧ ∀ (T : Finset V), T.card = 3 → ∃! X, X ∈ B ∧ T ⊆ X
def Mcd.IsSTS.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} S => (∀ T ∈ S, T.card = 3) ∧ ∀ (P : Finset V), P.card = 2 → ∃! T, T ∈ S ∧ P ⊆ T
def Mcd.derivedBlocks.{u} : {V : Type u} → [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → V → Finset (Finset V) :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B x => Finset.image (fun X => X.erase x) ({X ∈ B | x ∈ X})
def Mcd.IsPPC.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} D P => P.Nonempty ∧ P ⊆ D ∧ ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ T' ∈ P, T ≠ T' → Disjoint T T'
def Mcd.IsColouring.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset (Finset V)) → Prop :=
fun {V} D C => (∀ P ∈ C, Mcd.IsPPC D P) ∧ ∀ T ∈ D, ∃! P, P ∈ C ∧ T ∈ P
def Mcd.chiPrime : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun n => sInf {r | ∃ S, Mcd.IsSTS S ∧ ∃ C, Mcd.IsColouring S C ∧ C.card = r}
def Mcd.TargetColoured : ℕ → ℕ → Prop :=
fun v r => ∃ B, Mcd.IsSQS B ∧ ∀ (x : Fin v), ∃ C, Mcd.IsColouring (Mcd.derivedBlocks B x) C ∧ C.card = r
def Mcd.IsMcDSQS : {v : ℕ} → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) → Prop :=
fun {v} B => Mcd.IsSQS B ∧ ∀ (x : Fin v), ∃ C, Mcd.IsColouring (Mcd.derivedBlocks B x) C ∧ C.card = Mcd.chiPrime (v - 1)
def Mcd.TargetMc : ℕ → Prop :=
fun v => ∃ B, Mcd.IsMcDSQS B
def Mcd.ColourLowerBound.{u} : ℕ → ℕ → Prop :=
fun n r =>
  ∀ (W : Type u) [inst : Fintype W] [DecidableEq W],
    Fintype.card W = n →
      ∀ (S : Finset (Finset W)), Mcd.IsSTS S → ∀ (C : Finset (Finset (Finset W))), Mcd.IsColouring S C → r ≤ C.card
def Mcd.Kernel.pt : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → ℕ → Fin v :=
fun v [NeZero v] n => ⟨n % v, ⋯⟩
def Mcd.Kernel.quad : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Mcd.Kernel.RawQuad → Finset (Fin v) :=
fun v [NeZero v] b => {Mcd.Kernel.pt v b.1, Mcd.Kernel.pt v b.2.1, Mcd.Kernel.pt v b.2.2.1, Mcd.Kernel.pt v b.2.2.2}
def Mcd.Kernel.tri : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Mcd.Kernel.RawTriple → Finset (Fin v) :=
fun v [NeZero v] e => {Mcd.Kernel.pt v e.1, Mcd.Kernel.pt v e.2.1, Mcd.Kernel.pt v e.2.2}
@[irreducible] def Mcd.Kernel.blockSet : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → List Mcd.Kernel.RawQuad → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] bl => (List.map (Mcd.Kernel.quad v) bl).toFinset
@[irreducible] def Mcd.Kernel.tripleSet : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List Mcd.Kernel.RawTriple) → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] cls => (List.map (Mcd.Kernel.tri v) cls.flatten).toFinset
@[irreducible] def Mcd.Kernel.classSet : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List Mcd.Kernel.RawTriple) → Finset (Finset (Finset (Fin v))) :=
fun v [NeZero v] cls => (List.map (fun c => (List.map (Mcd.Kernel.tri v) c).toFinset) cls).toFinset
